verses.original: וַֽיְהִי־ אִ֣ישׁ מִבִּן־ יָמִין וּ֠שְׁמוֹ קִ֣ישׁ בֶּן־ אֲבִיאֵ֞ל בֶּן־ צְר֧וֹר בֶּן־ בְּכוֹרַ֛ת בֶּן־ אֲפִ֖יחַ בֶּן־ אִ֣ישׁ יְמִינִ֑י גִּבּ֖וֹר חָֽיִל׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî- ’îš mib·bin- yå̄·mīn ū·šə·mōw qîš ben- ’ă·ḇî·’êl ben- ṣə·rō·wr ben- bə·ḵō·w·raṯ ben- ’ă·p̄î·aḥ ben- ’îš yə·mî·nî gib·bō·wr ḥā·yil
verses.literal: Now there was a Benjamite a powerful man . . . . . . whose name was Kish son of Abiel the son of Zeror the son of Becorath the son of Aphiah - of Benjamin
verses.literalPt: Havia um homem de Benjamim por nome Quis, filho de Abiel, filho de Zeror, filho de Becorate, filho de Afia, filho dum benjamita, varão ilustre em valor.

verses.original: וְלוֹ־ הָיָ֨ה בֵ֜ן וּשְׁמ֤וֹ שָׁאוּל֙ בָּח֣וּר וָט֔וֹב וְאֵ֥ין אִ֛ישׁ מִבְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל ט֣וֹב מִמֶּ֑נּוּ מִשִּׁכְמ֣וֹ וָמַ֔עְלָה גָּבֹ֖הַּ מִכָּל־ הָעָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lōw- hā·yāh ḇên ū·šə·mōw šā·’ūl bā·ḥūr wā·ṭō·wḇ wə·’ên ’îš mib·bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ṭō·wḇ mim·men·nū miš·šiḵ·mōw wā·ma‘·lāh gā·ḇō·ah mik·kāl hā·‘ām
verses.literal: And he had a son named Saul choice and handsome without equal . . . . . . among the Israelites . . . a head . . . taller than any of the people
verses.literalPt: Ele tinha um filho chamado Saul, na flor da idade e belo. Não havia entre os filhos de Israel outro mais belo do que ele; desde os ombros para cima sobressaía a todo o povo.

verses.original: וַתֹּאבַ֙דְנָה֙ הָאֲתֹנ֔וֹת לְקִ֖ישׁ אֲבִ֣י שָׁא֑וּל וַיֹּ֨אמֶר קִ֜ישׁ אֶל־ שָׁא֣וּל בְּנ֗וֹ קַח־ נָ֤א אִתְּךָ֙ אֶת־ אַחַ֣ד מֵֽהַנְּעָרִ֔ים וְק֣וּם לֵ֔ךְ בַּקֵּ֖שׁ אֶת־ הָאֲתֹנֹֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·ḇaḏ·nāh hā·’ă·ṯō·nō·wṯ lə·qîš ’ă·ḇî šā·’ūl way·yō·mer qîš ’el- šā·’ūl bə·nōw qaḥ- nā ’it·tə·ḵā ’eṯ- ’a·ḥaḏ mê·han·nə·‘ā·rîm wə·qūm lêḵ baq·qêš ’eṯ- hā·’ă·ṯō·nōṯ
verses.literal: One day the donkeys of Saul’s father Kish wandered off and Kish said to his son Saul Take . . . one of the servants . . . - and go look for the donkeys
verses.literalPt: Tinham-se perdido as jumentas de Quis, pai de Saul. Disse Quis a seu filho Saul: Toma, agora, contigo um dos servos, levanta-te e vai procurar as jumentas.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲבֹ֧ר בְּהַר־ אֶפְרַ֛יִם וַיַּעֲבֹ֥ר בְּאֶֽרֶץ־ שָׁלִ֖שָׁה וְלֹ֣א מָצָ֑אוּ וַיַּעַבְר֤וּ בְאֶֽרֶץ־ שַׁעֲלִים֙ וָאַ֔יִן וַיַּעֲבֹ֥ר בְּאֶֽרֶץ־ יְמִינִ֖י וְלֹ֥א מָצָֽאוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·ḇōr bə·har- ’ep̄·ra·yim way·ya·‘ă·ḇōr bə·’e·reṣ- šā·li·šāh wə·lō mā·ṣā·’ū way·ya·‘aḇ·rū ḇə·’e·reṣ- ša·‘ă·lîm wā·’a·yin way·ya·‘ă·ḇōr bə·’e·reṣ- yə·mî·nî wə·lō mā·ṣā·’ū
verses.literal: So Saul passed through the hill country of Ephraim and then through the land of Shalishah but they did not find the donkeys He and the servant went through the region of Shaalim but they were not there . . . Then they went through the land of Benjamin and still they did not find them
verses.literalPt: Então, atravessando a região montanhosa de Efraim, como também a terra de Salisa, não as acharam; depois atravessaram a terra de Saalim, porém não estavam ali; e não as acharam também na terra de Benjamim.

verses.original: הֵ֗מָּה בָּ֚אוּ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ צ֔וּף וְשָׁא֥וּל אָמַ֛ר לְנַעֲר֥וֹ אֲשֶׁר־ עִמּ֖וֹ לְכָ֣ה וְנָשׁ֑וּבָה פֶּן־ יֶחְדַּ֥ל אָבִ֛י מִן־ הָאֲתֹנ֖וֹת וְדָ֥אַג לָֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hêm·māh bā·’ū bə·’e·reṣ ṣūp̄ wə·šā·’ūl ’ā·mar lə·na·‘ă·rōw ’ă·šer- ‘im·mōw lə·ḵāh wə·nā·šū·ḇāh pen- yeḥ·dal ’ā·ḇî min- hā·’ă·ṯō·nō·wṯ wə·ḏā·’aḡ lā·nū
verses.literal: When they reached the land of Zuph Saul said to his servant - Come let us go back or my father will stop worrying about the donkeys and start worrying about us
verses.literalPt: Tendo eles chegado à terra de Zufe, disse Saul para o servo que levava consigo: Vem, e voltemos; não suceda que meu pai deixe de pensar nas jumentas e que se aflija por nós.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗וֹ הִנֵּה־ נָ֤א אִישׁ־ אֱלֹהִים֙ בָּעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֔את וְהָאִ֣ישׁ נִכְבָּ֔ד כֹּ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ יְדַבֵּ֖ר בּ֣וֹא יָב֑וֹא עַתָּה֙ נֵ֣לֲכָה שָּׁ֔ם אוּלַי֙ יַגִּ֣יד לָ֔נוּ אֶת־ דַּרְכֵּ֖נוּ אֲשֶׁר־ הָלַ֥כְנוּ עָלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lōw hin·nêh- nā ’îš- ’ĕ·lō·hîm bā·‘îr haz·zōṯ wə·hā·’îš niḵ·bāḏ kōl ’ă·šer- yə·ḏab·bêr bō·w yā·ḇō·w ‘at·tāh nê·lă·ḵāh šām ’ū·lay yag·gîḏ lā·nū ’eṯ- dar·kê·nū ’ă·šer- hā·laḵ·nū ‘ā·le·hā
verses.literal: Look . . . said the servant in this city there is a man of God who is highly respected everything he says surely comes to pass . . . Let us go there now Perhaps he will tell us which way to go . . .
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe o servo: Eis que há, nesta cidade, um homem de Deus, e ele é muito considerado; tudo o que ele diz sucede infalivelmente. Vamos, pois, lá; porventura, ele nos pode informar sobre o caminho que seguimos.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר שָׁא֜וּל לְנַעֲר֗וֹ וְהִנֵּ֣ה נֵלֵךְ֮ וּמַה־ נָּבִ֣יא לָאִישׁ֒ כִּ֤י הַלֶּ֙חֶם֙ אָזַ֣ל מִכֵּלֵ֔ינוּ וּתְשׁוּרָ֥ה אֵין־ לְהָבִ֖יא לְאִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים מָ֖ה אִתָּֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šā·’ūl lə·na·‘ă·rōw wə·hin·nêh nê·lêḵ ū·mah- nā·ḇî lā·’îš kî hal·le·ḥem ’ā·zal mik·kê·lê·nū ū·ṯə·šū·rāh ’ên- lə·hā·ḇî lə·’îš hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm māh ’it·tā·nū
verses.literal: If we do go Saul replied what can we give the man For the bread in our packs is gone and there is no gift to take to the man of God What do we have
verses.literalPt: Então, disse Saul ao seu servo: Porém, se lá formos, que é o que levaremos ao homem? Pois já se acabou o pão dos nossos alforjes, e nenhum presente temos que levar ao homem de Deus. Que temos?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤סֶף הַנַּ֙עַר֙ לַעֲנ֣וֹת אֶת־ שָׁא֔וּל וַיֹּ֕אמֶר הִנֵּה֙ נִמְצָ֣א בְיָדִ֔י רֶ֖בַע שֶׁ֣קֶל כָּ֑סֶף וְנָֽתַתִּי֙ לְאִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים וְהִגִּ֥יד לָ֖נוּ אֶת־ דַּרְכֵּֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·sep̄ han·na·‘ar la·‘ă·nō·wṯ ’eṯ- šā·’ūl way·yō·mer hin·nêh nim·ṣā ḇə·yā·ḏî re·ḇa‘ še·qel kā·sep̄ wə·nā·ṯat·tî lə·’îš hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·hig·gîḏ lā·nū ’eṯ- dar·kê·nū
verses.literal: The servant answered him again Look he said I have here in my hand a quarter shekel of silver I will give it to the man of God and he will tell us our way
verses.literalPt: O servo tornou a responder a Saul: Eis que se acha na minha mão um quarto de siclo de prata. Dá-lo-ás ao homem de Deus, para que nos mostre o caminho

verses.original: לְפָנִ֣ים׀ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֤ר הָאִישׁ֙ בְּלֶכְתּוֹ֙ לִדְר֣וֹשׁ אֱלֹהִ֔ים לְכ֥וּ וְנֵלְכָ֖ה עַד־ הָרֹאֶ֑ה כִּ֤י לַנָּבִיא֙ הַיּ֔וֹם יִקָּרֵ֥א לְפָנִ֖ים הָרֹאֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lə·p̄ā·nîm bə·yiś·rā·’êl kōh- ’ā·mar hā·’îš bə·leḵ·tōw liḏ·rō·wōš ’ĕ·lō·hîm lə·ḵū wə·nê·lə·ḵāh ‘aḏ- hā·rō·’eh kî lan·nā·ḇî hay·yō·wm yiq·qā·rê lə·p̄ā·nîm hā·rō·’eh
verses.literal: Formerly in Israel . . . a man on his way to inquire of God would say Come let us go to the seer For the prophet of today was formerly called the seer
verses.literalPt: (Antigamente, em Israel, todo o que ia consultar a Deus dizia assim: Vinde, vamos ter com o vidente; porque aquele que, hoje, se chama profeta se chamava, outrora, vidente).

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר שָׁא֧וּל לְנַעֲר֛וֹ ט֥וֹב דְּבָרְךָ֖ לְכָ֣ה׀ נֵלֵ֑כָה וַיֵּֽלְכוּ֙ אֶל־ הָעִ֔יר אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁ֖ם אִ֥ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šā·’ūl lə·na·‘ă·rōw ṭō·wḇ də·ḇā·rə·ḵā lə·ḵāh nê·lê·ḵāh way·yê·lə·ḵū ’el- hā·‘îr ’ă·šer- šām ’îš hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: Good . . . said Saul to his servant Come let us go So they set out for the city where the man of God was
verses.literalPt: Disse Saul ao seu servo: Dizes bem, anda, vamos. Assim, subiram à cidade em que estava o homem de Deus.

verses.original: הֵ֗מָּה עֹלִים֙ בְּמַעֲלֵ֣ה הָעִ֔יר וְהֵ֙מָּה֙ מָצְא֣וּ נְעָר֔וֹת יֹצְא֖וֹת לִשְׁאֹ֣ב מָ֑יִם וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ לָהֶ֔ן הֲיֵ֥שׁ בָּזֶ֖ה הָרֹאֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hêm·māh ‘ō·lîm bə·ma·‘ă·lêh hā·‘îr wə·hêm·māh mā·ṣə·’ū nə·‘ā·rō·wṯ yō·ṣə·’ō·wṯ liš·’ōḇ mā·yim way·yō·mə·rū lā·hen hă·yêš bā·zeh hā·rō·’eh
verses.literal: And as they were climbing the hill to the city they met some young women coming out to draw water and asked Is the seer here . . .
verses.literalPt: Quando eles subiam pela encosta à cidade, encontraram umas moças que saíam a tirar água e lhes perguntaram: Está aqui o vidente?

verses.original: וַתַּעֲנֶ֧ינָה אוֹתָ֛ם וַתֹּאמַ֥רְנָה יֵּ֖שׁ הִנֵּ֣ה לְפָנֶ֑יךָ מַהֵ֣ר׀ עַתָּ֗ה כִּ֤י הַיּוֹם֙ בָּ֣א לָעִ֔יר כִּ֣י זֶ֧בַח הַיּ֛וֹם לָעָ֖ם בַּבָּמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wat·ta·‘ă·ne·nāh ’ō·w·ṯām wat·tō·mar·nāh yêš hin·nêh lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā ma·hêr ‘at·tāh kî hay·yō·wm bā lā·‘îr kî ze·ḇaḥ hay·yō·wm lā·‘ām bab·bā·māh
verses.literal: Yes he is ahead of you they answered - Hurry now for today he has come to the city because the people have a sacrifice on the high place
verses.literalPt: Elas lhes responderam: Está; ei-lo aí tens diante de ti. Apressa-te, porque hoje veio à cidade, porquanto o povo oferece hoje sacrifícios no alto.

verses.original: כְּבֹאֲכֶ֣ם הָעִ֣יר כֵּ֣ן תִּמְצְא֣וּן אֹת֡וֹ בְּטֶרֶם֩ יַעֲלֶ֨ה הַבָּמָ֜תָה לֶאֱכֹ֗ל כִּ֠י לֹֽא־ יֹאכַ֤ל הָעָם֙ עַד־ בֹּא֔וֹ כִּֽי־ הוּא֙ יְבָרֵ֣ךְ הַזֶּ֔בַח אַחֲרֵי־ כֵ֖ן יֹאכְל֣וּ הַקְּרֻאִ֑ים וְעַתָּ֣ה עֲל֔וּ כִּֽי־ אֹת֥וֹ כְהַיּ֖וֹם תִּמְצְא֥וּן אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kə·ḇō·’ă·ḵem hā·‘îr kên tim·ṣə·’ūn ’ō·ṯōw bə·ṭe·rem ya·‘ă·leh hab·bā·mā·ṯāh le·’ĕ·ḵōl kî lō- yō·ḵal hā·‘ām ‘aḏ- bō·’ōw kî- hū yə·ḇā·rêḵ haz·ze·ḇaḥ ’a·ḥă·rê- ḵên yō·ḵə·lū haq·qə·ru·’îm wə·‘at·tāh ‘ă·lū kî- ’ō·ṯōw ḵə·hay·yō·wm tim·ṣə·’ūn ’ō·ṯōw
verses.literal: As soon as you enter the city you will find him before he goes up to the high place to eat The people will not eat until he comes because he must bless the sacrifice after that . . . the guests . . . will eat Go up . . . at once you will find him
verses.literalPt: Ao entrardes na cidade, logo o encontrareis, antes que suba ao alto para comer; pois o povo não comerá, a menos que ele não tenha vindo, porque ele é quem há de abençoar o sacrifício; e, depois, comem os que forem convidados. Subi, agora, porque a esta hora o achareis.

verses.original: וַֽיַּעֲל֖וּ הָעִ֑יר הֵ֗מָּה בָּאִים֙ בְּת֣וֹךְ הָעִ֔יר וְהִנֵּ֤ה שְׁמוּאֵל֙ יֹצֵ֣א לִקְרָאתָ֔ם לַעֲל֖וֹת הַבָּמָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·lū hā·‘îr hêm·māh bā·’îm bə·ṯō·wḵ hā·‘îr wə·hin·nêh šə·mū·’êl yō·ṣê liq·rā·ṯām la·‘ă·lō·wṯ hab·bā·māh
verses.literal: So Saul and his servant went up toward the city and as they were entering . . . it there was Samuel coming toward them on his way up to the high place
verses.literalPt: E subiram à cidade; ao entrarem, saiu-lhes Samuel ao encontro, para subir ao alto.

verses.original: וַֽיהוָ֔ה גָּלָ֖ה אֶת־ אֹ֣זֶן שְׁמוּאֵ֑ל י֣וֹם אֶחָ֔ד לִפְנֵ֥י בֽוֹא־ שָׁא֖וּל לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh gā·lāh ’eṯ- ’ō·zen šə·mū·’êl yō·wm ’e·ḥāḏ lip̄·nê ḇō·w- šā·’ūl lê·mōr
verses.literal: Now on the day . . . before Saul’s . . . arrival the LORD had revealed - to Samuel
verses.literalPt: Ora, Jeová tinha revelado a Samuel a vinda de Saul um dia antes de ele chegar, dizendo:

verses.original: כָּעֵ֣ת׀ מָחָ֡ר אֶשְׁלַח֩ אֵלֶ֨יךָ אִ֜ישׁ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ בִּנְיָמִ֗ן וּמְשַׁחְתּ֤וֹ לְנָגִיד֙ עַל־ עַמִּ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְהוֹשִׁ֥יעַ אֶת־ עַמִּ֖י מִיַּ֣ד פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים כִּ֤י רָאִ֙יתִי֙ אֶת־ עַמִּ֔י כִּ֛י בָּ֥אָה צַעֲקָת֖וֹ אֵלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kā·‘êṯ mā·ḥār ’eš·laḥ ’ê·le·ḵā ’îš mê·’e·reṣ bin·yā·min ū·mə·šaḥ·tōw lə·nā·ḡîḏ ‘al- ‘am·mî yiś·rā·’êl wə·hō·wō·šî·a‘ ’eṯ- ‘am·mî mî·yaḏ pə·liš·tîm kî rā·’î·ṯî ’eṯ- ‘am·mî kî bā·’āh ṣa·‘ă·qā·ṯōw ’ê·lāy
verses.literal: At this time tomorrow I will send you a man from the land of Benjamin and you are to anoint him ruler over My people Israel he will save them from the hand of the Philistines For I have looked upon My people because their cry has come to Me
verses.literalPt: Amanhã, a esta hora, te enviarei um homem, que vem da terra de Benjamim, e tu o ungirás por príncipe sobre o meu povo de Israel. Ele livrará o meu povo da mão dos filisteus, pois olhei para o meu povo, porque o seu clamor chegou a mim.

verses.original: וּשְׁמוּאֵ֖ל רָאָ֣ה אֶת־ שָׁא֑וּל וַיהוָ֣ה עָנָ֔הוּ הִנֵּ֤ה הָאִישׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֣רְתִּי אֵלֶ֔יךָ זֶ֖ה יַעְצֹ֥ר בְּעַמִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·mū·’êl rā·’āh ’eṯ- šā·’ūl Yah·weh ‘ā·nā·hū hin·nêh hā·’îš ’ă·šer ’ā·mar·tî ’ê·le·ḵā zeh ya‘·ṣōr bə·‘am·mî
verses.literal: When Samuel saw Saul the LORD told him Here is the man of whom I spoke . . . he shall rule over My people
verses.literalPt: Quando Samuel viu a Saul, disse-lhe Jeová: Eis o homem de quem eu te disse: Este dominará sobre o meu povo.

verses.original: וַיִּגַּ֥שׁ שָׁא֛וּל אֶת־ שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל בְּת֣וֹךְ הַשָּׁ֑עַר וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ הַגִּֽידָה־ נָּ֣א לִ֔י אֵי־ זֶ֖ה בֵּ֥ית הָרֹאֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yig·gaš šā·’ūl ’eṯ- šə·mū·’êl bə·ṯō·wḵ haš·šā·‘ar way·yō·mer hag·gî·ḏāh- nā lî ’ê- zeh bêṯ hā·rō·’eh
verses.literal: Saul approached Samuel in the gateway and asked Would you please tell me where the seer’s house is
verses.literalPt: Então, Saul se chegou a Samuel, na porta, e disse: Peço-te que me digas onde é a casa do vidente.

verses.original: וַיַּ֨עַן שְׁמוּאֵ֜ל אֶת־ שָׁא֗וּל וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אָנֹכִ֣י הָרֹאֶ֔ה עֲלֵ֤ה לְפָנַי֙ הַבָּמָ֔ה וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֥ם עִמִּ֖י הַיּ֑וֹם וְשִׁלַּחְתִּ֣יךָ בַבֹּ֔קֶר וְכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּֽלְבָבְךָ֖ אַגִּ֥יד לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an šə·mū·’êl ’eṯ- šā·’ūl way·yō·mer ’ā·nō·ḵî hā·rō·’eh ‘ă·lêh lə·p̄ā·nay hab·bā·māh wa·’ă·ḵal·tem ‘im·mî hay·yō·wm wə·šil·laḥ·tî·ḵā ḇab·bō·qer wə·ḵōl ’ă·šer bil·ḇā·ḇə·ḵā ’ag·gîḏ lāḵ
verses.literal: I am the seer Samuel - . . . replied Go up before me to the high place for you shall eat with me today And when I send you off in the morning I will tell you all that is in your heart
verses.literalPt: Samuel respondeu a Saul: Eu sou o vidente. Sobe adiante de mim ao alto, porque hoje comereis comigo; pela manhã, te despedirei e descobrir-te-ei tudo o que tens no teu coração.

verses.original: וְלָאֲתֹנ֞וֹת הָאֹבְד֣וֹת לְךָ֗ הַיּוֹם֙ שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת הַיָּמִ֔ים אַל־ תָּ֧שֶׂם אֶֽת־ לִבְּךָ֛ לָהֶ֖ם כִּ֣י נִמְצָ֑אוּ וּלְמִי֙ כָּל־ חֶמְדַּ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הֲל֣וֹא לְךָ֔ וּלְכֹ֖ל בֵּ֥ית אָבִֽיךָ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·’ă·ṯō·nō·wṯ hā·’ō·ḇə·ḏō·wṯ lə·ḵā hay·yō·wm šə·lō·šeṯ hay·yā·mîm ’al- tā·śem ’eṯ- lib·bə·ḵā lā·hem kî nim·ṣā·’ū ū·lə·mî kāl- ḥem·daṯ yiś·rā·’êl hă·lō·w lə·ḵā ū·lə·ḵōl bêṯ ’ā·ḇî·ḵā
verses.literal: As for the donkeys you lost . . . three days ago do not worry - about them for they have been found And upon whom is all the desire of Israel if not upon you and all your father’s house
verses.literalPt: Pelo que toca às tuas jumentas que há três dias se perderam, não te dê isso cuidado, porque já se acharam. Para quem é tudo o que é desejável em Israel? Não é, porventura, para ti e para toda a casa de teu pai?

verses.original: וַיַּ֨עַן שָׁא֜וּל וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הֲל֨וֹא בֶן־ יְמִינִ֤י אָ֙נֹכִי֙ מִקַּטַנֵּי֙ שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּמִשְׁפַּחְתִּי֙ הַצְּעִרָ֔ה מִכָּֽל־ מִשְׁפְּח֖וֹת שִׁבְטֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֑ן וְלָ֙מָּה֙ דִּבַּ֣רְתָּ אֵלַ֔י כַּדָּבָ֖ר הַזֶּֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an šā·’ūl way·yō·mer hă·lō·w ḇen- yə·mî·nî ’ā·nō·ḵî miq·qa·ṭan·nē šiḇ·ṭê yiś·rā·’êl ū·miš·paḥ·tî haṣ·ṣə·‘i·rāh mik·kāl miš·pə·ḥō·wṯ šiḇ·ṭê ḇin·yā·min wə·lām·māh dib·bar·tā ’ê·lay kad·dā·ḇār haz·zeh
verses.literal: Saul . . . replied Am I not a Benjamite from the smallest tribe of Israel and is not my clan the least of all the clans of Benjamin So why would you say such a thing . . . to me
verses.literalPt: Respondeu Saul: Acaso, não sou eu benjamita, da mais pequena das tribos de Israel? Não é a minha família a menor de todas as famílias da tribo de Benjamim? Por que me falas tu logo assim?

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֤ח שְׁמוּאֵל֙ אֶת־ שָׁא֣וּל וְאֶֽת־ נַעֲר֔וֹ וַיְבִיאֵ֖ם לִשְׁכָּ֑תָה וַיִּתֵּ֨ן לָהֶ֤ם מָקוֹם֙ בְּרֹ֣אשׁ הַקְּרוּאִ֔ים וְהֵ֖מָּה כִּשְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אִֽישׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ šə·mū·’êl ’eṯ- šā·’ūl wə·’eṯ- na·‘ă·rōw way·ḇî·’êm liš·kā·ṯāh way·yit·tên lā·hem mā·qō·wm bə·rōš haq·qə·rū·’îm wə·hêm·māh kiš·lō·šîm ’îš
verses.literal: Then Samuel took Saul and his servant brought them into the hall and seated them in the place of honor among those who were invited . . . about thirty in all
verses.literalPt: Samuel, tomando a Saul e ao seu servo, levou-os para a sala de jantar e deu-lhes o primeiro lugar entre os convidados, que eram cerca de trinta pessoas.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל֙ לַטַּבָּ֔ח תְּנָה֙ אֶת־ הַמָּנָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לָ֑ךְ אֲשֶׁר֙ אָמַ֣רְתִּי אֵלֶ֔יךָ שִׂ֥ים אֹתָ֖הּ עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šə·mū·’êl laṭ·ṭab·bāḥ tə·nāh ’eṯ- ham·mā·nāh ’ă·šer nā·ṯat·tî lāḵ ’ă·šer ’ā·mar·tî ’ê·le·ḵā śîm ’ō·ṯāh ‘im·māḵ
verses.literal: And Samuel said to the cook Bring the portion I gave you and told . . . you to set aside
verses.literalPt: Samuel disse ao cozinheiro: Traze a porção que te dei e que mandei que guardasses à parte.

verses.original: וַיָּ֣רֶם הַ֠טַּבָּח אֶת־ הַשּׁ֨וֹק וְהֶעָלֶ֜יהָ וַיָּ֣שֶׂם׀ לִפְנֵ֣י שָׁא֗וּל וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ הִנֵּ֤ה הַנִּשְׁאָר֙ שִׂים־ לְפָנֶ֣יךָ אֱכֹ֔ל כִּ֧י לַמּוֹעֵ֛ד שָֽׁמוּר־ לְךָ֥ לֵאמֹ֖ר הָעָ֣ם׀ קָרָ֑אתִי וַיֹּ֧אכַל שָׁא֛וּל עִם־ שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל בַּיּ֥וֹם הַהֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·rem haṭ·ṭab·bāḥ ’eṯ- haš·šō·wq wə·he·‘ā·le·hā way·yā·śem lip̄·nê šā·’ūl way·yō·mer hin·nêh han·niš·’ār śîm- lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā ’ĕ·ḵōl kî lam·mō·w·‘êḏ šā·mūr- lə·ḵā lê·mōr hā·‘ām qā·rā·ṯî way·yō·ḵal šā·’ūl ‘im- šə·mū·’êl bay·yō·wm ha·hū
verses.literal: So the cook picked up the leg and what was attached to it and set it before Saul Then Samuel said Here is what was kept back It was set apart for you Eat for it has been kept for you for this occasion from the time I said I have invited the people So Saul dined with Samuel that day
verses.literalPt: Tomou o cozinheiro a espádua e o que nela havia e pô-la diante de Saul. Samuel disse: Eis o que foi reservado! Põe-no diante de ti e come; porque se te reservou para ti até o tempo determinado, ao dizer eu: Convidei o povo. Assim, comeu Saul com Samuel naquele dia.

verses.original: וַיֵּרְד֥וּ מֵהַבָּמָ֖ה הָעִ֑יר וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר עִם־ שָׁא֖וּל עַל־ הַגָּֽג׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·rə·ḏū mê·hab·bā·māh hā·‘îr way·ḏab·bêr ‘im- šā·’ūl ‘al- hag·gāḡ
verses.literal: And after they had come down from the high place into the city Samuel spoke with Saul on the roof of his house
verses.literalPt: Tendo eles descido do alto para a cidade, falou Samuel com Saul, no eirado.

verses.original: וַיַּשְׁכִּ֗מוּ וַיְהִ֞י כַּעֲל֤וֹת הַשַּׁ֙חַר֙ וַיִּקְרָ֨א שְׁמוּאֵ֤ל אֶל־ שָׁאוּל֙ הַגָּג לֵאמֹ֔ר ק֖וּמָה וַאֲשַׁלְּחֶ֑ךָּ וַיָּ֣קָם שָׁא֗וּל וַיֵּצְא֧וּ שְׁנֵיהֶ֛ם ה֥וּא וּשְׁמוּאֵ֖ל הַחֽוּצָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaš·ki·mū way·hî ka·‘ă·lō·wṯ haš·ša·ḥar way·yiq·rā šə·mū·’êl ’el- šā·’ūl hag·gå̄ḡ lê·mōr qū·māh wa·’ă·šal·lə·ḥe·kā way·yā·qām šā·’ūl way·yê·ṣə·’ū šə·nê·hem hū ū·šə·mū·’êl ha·ḥū·ṣāh
verses.literal: They got up early in the morning . . . and just before dawn Samuel called to Saul on the roof . . . Get ready and I will send you on your way So Saul got ready and both he and Samuel went outside together
verses.literalPt: Levantaram-se cedo; e, ao raiar do dia, chamou Samuel a Saul, no eirado, dizendo: Levanta-te para eu te despedir. Levantou-se Saul, e saíram ambos para fora, ele e Samuel.

verses.original: הֵ֗מָּה יֽוֹרְדִים֙ בִּקְצֵ֣ה הָעִ֔יר וּשְׁמוּאֵ֞ל אָמַ֣ר אֶל־ שָׁא֗וּל אֱמֹ֥ר לַנַּ֛עַר וְיַעֲבֹ֥ר לְפָנֵ֖ינוּ וַֽיַּעֲבֹ֑ר וְאַתָּה֙ עֲמֹ֣ד כַּיּ֔וֹם וְאַשְׁמִיעֲךָ֖ אֶת־ דְּבַ֥ר אֱלֹהִֽים׃פ
verses.transliteration: hêm·māh yō·wr·ḏîm biq·ṣêh hā·‘îr ū·šə·mū·’êl ’ā·mar ’el- šā·’ūl ’ĕ·mōr lan·na·‘ar wə·ya·‘ă·ḇōr lə·p̄ā·nê·nū way·ya·‘ă·ḇōr wə·’at·tāh ‘ă·mōḏ kay·yō·wm wə·’aš·mî·‘ă·ḵā ’eṯ- də·ḇar ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: As they were going down to the edge of the city Samuel said to Saul Tell the servant to go on ahead of us but you stay for a while and I will reveal to you the word of God So the servant went on
verses.literalPt: Eles desciam e se achavam na extremidade da cidade, quando Samuel disse a Saul: Manda ao servo que vá adiante de nós (E ele foi.), mas tu demora-te aqui, para que eu te faça saber a palavra de Deus.
